interpretation: The principal (baseline 512x8) and the trap negative control (trial-75 128x6, guardrail-FAIL network) sit at cosine distance 0.198 and L2 8.95 in the 57-dim canonical space: clearly separated regions despite sharing the same architecture family and loss. The refined fine-tune converged back onto the baseline itself (distance 0.0), so the principal-vs-feed comparison that matters is principal vs trap: the surrogate-optimal network is ~20% of a unit sphere away from the system-optimal one, and the val-loss gradient points toward that distant region, not toward the baseline. This quantifies, in weight space, why surrogate-level HPO cannot walk from the trap back to the baseline and why the guardrail, not the surrogate, must remain the adoption criterion.
